text:
jamie: AcmePayments (private VPC) reporting no metrics in Console since 07:12 UTC after we rotated the auth-proxy token. Support ticket #3251. Their Prometheus scrape counts are normal, but Console shows empty charts. Can someone triage? :eyes:

devon: Seen similar earlier. Any 403/401 in telemetry collector logs? Also did we change header passthrough in the proxy canary?

maria: I checked the logs briefly — collector shows a bunch of 400s with "missing tenant" and some 401s from auth service starting at 07:11:45. Wire logs inbound to gateway show X-Redwood-Tenant present.

lucas: Can you paste the gateway -> collector request headers and a sample curl? We need to know whether the header is stripped by the proxy.

jamie: Sample curl from customer (sanitized):

``
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: acme-payments" https://private-collector.prod/v1/ingest -d '@metrics.json'
```

jamie: At gateway (nginx canary) access log shows X-Redwood-Tenant=acme-payments. Collector access log shows no X-Redwood-Tenant header.

devon: That points to the authz sidecar or envoy filter removing the header. We rolled out auth-proxy v2.3.1 at 07:10 UTC (canary 10%). Canary config included `strip_sensitive_headers: true` — probable culprit.

maria: Repro steps I ran in staging: deploy auth-proxy v2.3.1 -> send inbound with tenant header -> collector receives none. Reverting to v2.3.0 brings header back. :white_check_mark:

lucas: Immediate mitigation: flip canary back or set proxy config `preserve_headers: ["x-redwood-tenant"]` in live canary. Also update telemetry collector to accept tenant via JWT claim as fallback (short-term).

jamie: Can infra rollback the canary? Customer is impacted and charts are blank. Ticket escalated to P1.

devon: Rolling back canary now. Pushing v2.3.0 to the canary group — ETA ~4 min.

telemetry-bot: deploy v2.3.0 started by devon @ 07:20:15 UTC — tracking #deploy-778

maria: After rollback metrics started to flow at ~07:25 UTC. Verified Console dashboards for acme-payments show time-series resuming. I'll add a postmortem note to ticket #3251 and a follow-up to add automated header smoke tests.

jamie: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: (1) add header-preservation test to CI, (2) add collector fallback to read tenant from JWT, (3) audit other proxy config flags that could strip custom headers. I'll update the customer.

lucas: Filed infra task INF-452 to add preserve_headers flag to rollout checklist.

maria: Recording root cause as "auth-proxy canary changed default to strip custom headers (strip_sensitive_headers=true), which removed X-Redwood-Tenant from requests to telemetry collector, causing collector to drop or attribute metrics to unknown tenant."
